## Ingredients
- patty #01 (raw; grillable from raw)
- steak #01 (raw; cuttable from raw; grillable after marinating) [must be cut, then marinated before grilling]
- fish #01 (raw; fryable from raw)
- potato #01 (raw; cuttable from raw; fryable after cut) [must be cut before frying]
- yam #01 (raw; boilable from raw; mashable after boiling)
- lettuce #01 (raw; cuttable from raw)
- cucumber #01 (raw; cuttable from raw)
- stock #01 (raw; boilable from raw)
- bun bot (ready to use)
- bun top (ready to use)

## Available Actions
- **grill** `<item>`  —  Grill an item on the grill. Takes 10 seconds. Produces a grilled item. NOTE: some items must be marinated before they can be grilled (see ingredients).
- **cut** `<item>`  —  Chop a raw item on the cutting board. Takes 3 seconds. Produces a cut item.
- **fry** `<item>`  —  Fry an item in a fryer. Takes 8 seconds. Produces a fried item. NOTE: some items must be cut before they can be fried (see ingredients).
- **boil** `<item>`  —  Boil an item. Takes 12 seconds. Produces a boiled item.
- **marinate** `<item>`  —  Marinate a cut item. Takes 6 seconds. Produces a marinated item. The item must be cut first.
- **mash** `<item>`  —  Mash a boiled item on the cutting board. Takes 4 seconds. Produces a mashed item. The item must be boiled first.
- **stack** `<item>`  —  Place an ingredient on top of the current stack. Takes 1 second. The item must already be in its required state before stacking.

## Station Constraints
- **grill**: capacity 3 (at most 3 grill actions running at once)
- **cutting board**: capacity 3 (at most 3 cut/mash actions running at once)
- **fryer**: capacity 2 (at most 2 fry actions running at once)
- **boiler**: capacity 2 (at most 2 boil actions running at once)
- **marinator**: capacity 2 (at most 2 marinate actions running at once)

## Robot Constraints
Each action must be assigned to exactly one robot.
A robot can run at most one action at a time.
Available robots:
- robot1
- robot2
- robot3

## Goal
The following ingredients must be prepared:
- patty #01 must be grilled
- steak #01 must be grilled
- fish #01 must be fried
- potato #01 must be fried
- yam #01 must be mashed
- lettuce #01 must be cut
- cucumber #01 must be cut
- stock #01 must be boiled

Assemble the final dish by stacking the ingredients in this order (bottom to top):
  1. bun bot
  2. grilled patty #01
  3. cut lettuce #01
  4. grilled steak #01
  5. cut cucumber #01
  6. bun top

    robot1 robot2 robot3 - robot
  )

    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (robot_free ?r - robot)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)

    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (robot_free ?r)) (at start (boiler_free)))

    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked bun_bot)) (at end (robot_free ?r))))

    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable patty01))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked patty01)) (at end (robot_free ?r))))
